newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Power NZ drops proceedings against NZSE.
newsitem.headline: Power NZ drops proceedings against NZSE.

text.p: Power New Zealand Ltd said on Wednesday it had dropped its court proceedings against the New Zealand Stock Exchange and Members of the Market Surveillance Panel, following discussions between the parties.

The proceedings, issued in August 1996, concerned certain standstill agreements between the various Territorial Local Authorities ("TLAs") and Power New Zealand, relating to the TLAs' shareholdings in Power New Zealand and the Panel's requirements in respect of those agreements.
The agreements contained a provision which imposed a restriction on transferability of the Power New Zealand shares held by the TLAs.
